title: Blizzard Assault AT-AT
text: When this unit attacks and defeats a unit: You may deal the excess damage from this attack to an enemy ground unit.
rules:
(ERRATA) While attacking, this unit may deal its excess damage to an enemy ground unit.
If Blizzard Assault AT-AT is given Overwhelm, its controller chooses whether to apply the excess damage from its attack to a unit or to the defending player's base.
